01-01.title: Your First Page
01-01.text: A new year is three hundred and sixty-five blank pages, and today you pick up the pen. Let's fill this one with new words.

02-14.title: Falling for Language
02-14.text: You don't need anyone else's love language when you're busy building your own, one new phrase at a time. Keep falling for the words that let you say exactly what you mean.

04-22.title: Roots Before Branches
04-22.text: The tallest trees spend years growing quiet roots before anyone sees a single leaf. Your vocabulary is doing that same work right now, out of sight and very much alive.

07-30.title: A Passport Made of Words
07-30.text: Somewhere today, a stranger is one shared sentence away from becoming a friend. Every phrase you learn is another door you can open toward them.

10-31.title: Braver Than Any Costume
10-31.text: Speaking up in a new language takes more nerve than any costume ever could. Wear that courage tonight; it suits you.

11-24.title: A Thankful Pause
11-24.text: Before the next lesson, notice everything you can already say that you couldn't say when this year began. That's not luck, that's practice, and it's worth celebrating today.

12-25.title: The Gift You Gave Yourself
12-25.text: Under all the wrapping paper this year is a quieter gift: months of showing up for yourself, one lesson at a time. Nobody can unwrap that one but you, and nobody can take it away.

12-31.title: Read This Year Back
12-31.text: Scroll back through everything you've learned since January; that person could barely imagine tonight's conversation. Close the year knowing you gave it something real.
